purpose: Authoritative status and input checklist for the custom schematic footprints required before PCB conversion
editor_rule: Pad numbers must match schematic pin numbers one-to-one. Similar names or visually similar land patterns are not sufficient.

footprints.name: BQ24074_RGT0016B_TI_LAND
footprints.validation: The active BQ24074 package figure calls the package RGT0016B. The current TI package appendix provides the compatible RGT0016C land pattern used here. Footprint-manager mapping and pad dimensions were checked; optional 0.20 mm thermal vias were intentionally omitted.
footprints.rejected: The inspected VQFN-16 candidate used 0.28 x 0.80 mm peripheral pads.

footprints.name: TPD1E10B06_DPY_X1SON2_TI_LAND
footprints.validation: TI Rev. G DPY0002A example board layout and the 嘉立创EDA footprint manager both show two 0.30 x 0.50 mm lands on 0.70 mm center pitch. D1, D2, and D3 each map pins 1-2 one-to-one.
footprints.rejected: The inspected library candidates used 0.4 x 0.6 mm or 0.6 x 0.5 mm pads.

footprints.name: USB4105_GF_A_060_GCT_17PIN_RECT
footprints.pins: A1, A4-A9, A12, B1, B4-B9, B12, and four coincident-number SH mounting pads
footprints.validation: Imported through a minimal KiCad 5 PCB wrapper using the official contact coordinates and land sizes. The editor exposes all 16 A/B contact names plus four SH pads; the footprint manager accepted all 17 symbol-to-pad mappings. A1/B12 and A4/B9 remain separate coincident numbered pads. The signal lands are represented internally as numbered polygon pads and show 0.000 x 0.000 mil in the manager's size summary, so PCB DRC and Gerber inspection are required before release.
footprints.controlled_deviation: The imported signal lands use the same 0.60 x 1.15 mm or 0.30 x 1.15 mm bounding boxes as the official pattern but rectangular rather than rounded corners, because the standard-edition KiCad importer dropped pad numbers from roundrect pads.
footprints.rejected: Inspected user candidates merge A1/B12 and A4/B9 and use S1-S4. The first imported personal-library version USB4105_GF_A_060_GCT_17PIN preserved rounded geometry but lost every A/B signal pad number during conversion, so it must not be assigned.

footprints.name: 2450AT18D0100001E_CIRCULAR_THIN_EDGE_4PAD
footprints.pins: 1-4 kept separate so terminal 4 remains on ANT_TUNE
footprints.mounting_configuration: Johanson circular-PCB/thin-edge pattern with separate terminals. Keep the documented clearance area free of copper on every layer and free of components, batteries, and displays on both sides.
footprints.validation: The footprint manager listed pads 1-4 separately at 39.370 x 23.620 mil each and accepted the one-to-one ANT1 pin mapping. Exact pad centers come from the version-controlled KiCad 5 wrapper. The imported footprint does not itself prove the final all-layer keepout or RF performance; enforce the clearance during PCB layout and tune R30/C30/C31/R31 in the assembled pen.
footprints.rejected: The exact legacy-name candidate merges terminals 2-4 as pad 2; a separate-pad D100E candidate is not the exact part and used 1.5 x 0.8 mm lands.

footprints.name: BATTERY_WIRE_3PAD_COMPACT
footprints.validation: Imported into the personal library and bound one-to-one. The 3D-printed enclosure must provide strain relief. The standard-edition importer may show 0.000 x 0.000 mil for imported rectangular polygon pads, so verify the 1.50 x 2.00 mm source geometry in PCB and Gerber output before release.

footprints.name: POGO_RECOVERY_6PAD_COMPACT
footprints.validation: Imported into the personal library and bound one-to-one; the footprint manager reported six 39.370 x 39.370 mil round pads with 50 mil horizontal and vertical pitch. Freeze the orientation only together with the programming-jig drawing.

footprints.name: POWER_SWITCH_WIRE_2PAD_COMPACT
footprints.validation: Imported into the personal library and bound one-to-one. The 3D-printed enclosure must provide strain relief. The standard-edition importer may show 0.000 x 0.000 mil for imported rectangular polygon pads, so verify the 1.50 x 2.00 mm source geometry in PCB and Gerber output before release.

online_boundary: All custom footprints in this file have been saved to the 嘉立创EDA personal footprint library and bound in the online schematic. The final manager recount showed all 60 schematic components bound. The unnumbered first-import J1 footprint must not be assigned.
erc_boundary: The Standard Edition schematic Design Manager was manually refreshed after binding. It showed 60 components and 37 / 37 networks, and the expanded network list contained no exclamation mark or error description.

PCB_round_sensor_SCH_A2 has a provisional 30 mm circular outline; components are still staged outside it.
